PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),   # input CS device gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),     # input device length
    "I1":    (18e-6, 12e-6, 24e-6),# total CS current (= IREF + PMOS source)
    "Isf":   (10e-6, 5e-6, 15e-6), # follower current
    "gmsf":  (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),    # follower gm/Id
    "Lsf":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),     # follower length
    "Rf":    (390e3, 360e3, 520e3),# feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (1e-15, 1e-16, 2e-14),# feedback cap (peaking control)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    I1 = max(p["I1"], iref + 1e-6)
    Ip = I1 - iref                                  # PMOS source current
    Isf = p["Isf"]; Rf = p["Rf"]; Cf = p["Cf"]; Idiv = 1e-6

    # first-pass DC levels
    vin_dc = 0.47
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.1)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs                                  # vout_dc = vin_dc (no DC current in Rf)
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=vdd - (vin_dc + 0.65), vsb=vin_dc)
    vx = vin_dc + msf.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=vdd - vx, vsb=vin_dc)
    vx = vin_dc + msf.vgs
    mp = lut.size("p", 8.0, 1.0, Ip, vds=max(vdd - vx, 0.2))
    Rt = vin_dc / Isf                                # resistive tail for follower

    # PMOS gate bias by divider (+ bypass cap to kill its noise)
    vpg = vdd - mp.vgs
    Ra = mp.vgs / Idiv; Rb = vpg / Idiv

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # gain node X == ibias (IREF is the high-impedance load)
    n.dev("M1", "ibias", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MP", "ibias", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RA", "vdd", "pg", Ra); n.R("RB", "pg", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("CB", "pg", "vdd", 2e-12)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.R("RT", "vout", "vss", Rt)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # small-signal 3-node AC model
    cgd1 = m1.cgd; cgs1 = max(m1.cgg - m1.cgd, 0.0)
    Cin = cpd + cgs1
    gx = m1.gds + mp.gds
    Cx = max(m1.cdd - cgd1, 0.0) + mp.cdd + msf.cgd
    cgs_sf = max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0)
    gsf, gmb, gdsf = msf.gm, msf.gmbs, msf.gds
    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    zt = np.zeros(len(f))
    for i, fi in enumerate(f):
        s = 2j * PI * fi
        Gf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        Y = np.array([
            [s*Cin + Gf + s*cgd1, -s*cgd1, -Gf],
            [m1.gm - s*cgd1, gx + s*Cx + s*cgd1 + s*cgs_sf, -s*cgs_sf],
            [-Gf, -s*cgs_sf - gsf, s*cl + 1.0/Rt + Gf + s*cgs_sf + gsf + gmb + gdsf]],
            dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0, 0], dtype=complex))
        zt[i] = abs(v[2])
    z0 = zt[0]
    idx = np.where(zt < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else f[-1]

    # noise at 1 MHz: Rf thermal + M1 en*w*Ct + PMOS load (current at X / (gm1 Rf))
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    i_rf2 = 4 * kT / Rf
    en1_2 = 4 * kT * 0.8 / m1.gm
    i_m1_2 = en1_2 * (w * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2 + en1_2 / Rf ** 2
    rth = Ra * Rb / (Ra + Rb)
    vg2 = 4 * kT * rth / (1 + (w * rth * 2e-12) ** 2)
    i_p_x2 = 4 * kT * 0.8 * mp.gm + vg2 * mp.gm ** 2
    i_p2 = i_p_x2 / (m1.gm * Rf) ** 2
    in_noise = math.sqrt(i_rf2 + i_m1_2 + i_p2)

    power = vdd * (iref + Ip + Isf + Idiv)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(z0), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vin_dc, "in_noise_1m": in_noise}
